# Hardware report

Thank you for contributing target information.

Please report only what you directly observed. Where something is uncertain, use `UNKNOWN` rather than guessing.

Do not upload proprietary firmware, NVM dumps, credentials, VINs, home addresses, Wi-Fi passwords, or other unnecessary personal information.
